title: Transitions 2045: Socioeconomic Forecast Interactive Map
discovery_method: Rendered-browser inspection followed by recursive ArcGIS item-data and service dependency traversal

views.title: Forecast_2045_County
views.notes: The rendered app exposes county tables and charts for 2020 estimates, 2045 forecasts, and numeric and percentage change. Its Full Table control opens an embedded dashboard rather than a separate authoritative download.

views.title: Forecast_2045_DASZ
views.notes: The small-area view maps the approved forecast by Data Analysis Subzone. The service is the interactive representation of the same forecast already preserved in MRMPO's authoritative regional and Bernalillo County workbooks.

archival_reconciliation.reason: The authoritative forecast presentation, regional workbook, Bernalillo County workbook, and DASZ data dictionary are already archived in R2 and linked from content/city-data/demographics.md. ArcGIS app configurations and embedded guide screenshots are interface components, not superior archival substitutes for those downloads.

site_action: No content change required; the existing Demographics and Dashboards links accurately describe and link the live app, while the Demographics page provides the preserved source files.
processing_notes: The short URL and final portfolio URL were both tested in the rendered browser.
ArcGIS item metadata and application JSON were reviewed recursively rather than treating the portfolio shell as a terminal page.
No undiscovered authoritative PDF, workbook, CSV, or other downloadable source document was referenced by the app configuration.
